upstream.description: The world's simplest facial recognition api for Python and the command line

classification.analysis: The classic, widely-used Python library and CLI ('the world's simplest facial recognition API') built on dlib's deep-learning face recognition model, claiming 99.38% accuracy on the LFW benchmark. Provides face detection, facial-landmark extraction, and face-matching/identification from both a Python API and the face_recognition/face_detection command-line tools, with Docker images for CPU/GPU. Long-running, mature project (since 2017) used by developers building face-based identification, webcam recognition, or digital-makeup style demos.

use_cases.title: Identify known people in a folder of photos from the command line
Build real-time webcam face recognition into a Python app
Extract facial landmarks for filters or digital makeup effects
Batch-process a large photo set to find and box all faces
